2.source: Biomes with savanna, plains or snowy villages, and inside the Red Ribbon Tower
2.translation: Biomas com vilas de savana, de planície ou nevadas, e dentro da Torre da Red Ribbon

3.source: Attacks players and villagers on sight
3.translation: Ataca jogadores e aldeões assim que os vê

5.translation: Redstone, Pepitas de ferro, Barras de ferro

6.source: The '''Red Ribbon Army''' fields soldiers and robots that patrol the land around [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]'s villages and garrison the [[Special:MyLanguage/Red Ribbon Tower|Red Ribbon Tower]], which keeps spawning them inside its walls. They attack players and villagers alike.
6.translation: O '''Exército Red Ribbon''' coloca em campo soldados e robôs que patrulham as terras ao redor das vilas da [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Terra]] e guarnecem a [[Special:MyLanguage/Red Ribbon Tower|Torre da Red Ribbon]], que continua gerando-os dentro de suas muralhas. Eles atacam jogadores e aldeões sem distinção.

11.source: Biomes with savanna, plains or snowy villages (weight 30, groups of 1–3), and inside the Red Ribbon Tower (weight 100, groups of 2–4)
11.translation: Biomas com vilas de savana, de planície ou nevadas (peso 30, grupos de 1–3), e dentro da Torre da Red Ribbon (peso 100, grupos de 2–4)

12.translation:
'''Drops:'''
* 1–3 '''Redstone''' (+0–1 com Pilhagem)
* 1–3 '''Pepita de ferro''' (+0–1 com Pilhagem)

14.source: Three robot models share the same stats, drops and spawn conditions; they only differ in model and spawn rate.
14.translation: Três modelos de robô compartilham os mesmos atributos, drops e condições de surgimento; só mudam o modelo e a frequência de surgimento.

18.source: Biomes with savanna, plains or snowy villages (first model weight 5, second and third weight 10, always alone), and inside the Red Ribbon Tower (weights 43, 42 and 41, groups of 1–2)
18.translation: Biomas com vilas de savana, de planície ou nevadas (primeiro modelo peso 5, segundo e terceiro peso 10, sempre sozinhos), e dentro da Torre da Red Ribbon (pesos 43, 42 e 41, grupos de 1–2)

19.translation:
'''Drops (cada modelo):'''
* 1–2 '''Barra de ferro''' (+0–1 com Pilhagem)
* 1–2 '''Redstone''' (+0–1 com Pilhagem)

21.source: Soldiers and robots are '''wild enemies''': out in the open they spawn under open sky, day or night, away from torches and other light. The [[Special:MyLanguage/Red Ribbon Tower|Red Ribbon Tower]], a Red Ribbon outpost found in most land biomes, also spawns them indoors in dim spots (block light 7 or less), and vanilla monsters don't spawn in it. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Bestiary#How wild enemies spawn|how wild enemies spawn]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Structures]].
21.translation: Soldados e robôs são '''inimigos selvagens''': ao ar livre, surgem a céu aberto, de dia ou de noite, longe de tochas e outras luzes. A [[Special:MyLanguage/Red Ribbon Tower|Torre da Red Ribbon]], um posto avançado da Red Ribbon encontrado na maioria dos biomas terrestres, também os gera em ambientes internos, em pontos escuros (luz de bloco 7 ou menos), e os monstros vanilla não surgem nela. Veja [[Special:MyLanguage/Bestiary#How wild enemies spawn|como surgem os inimigos selvagens]] e [[Special:MyLanguage/Structures|Estruturas]].

23.source: The [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] pits you against the army's officers: Colonel Silver in '''The Red Ribbon Army''', then General Red in '''Red Ribbon Headquarters''' and General Black's Robot in '''Officer Black's Battle Robot''', both at the Red Ribbon Tower.
23.translation: A [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Saga Clássica]] coloca você contra os oficiais do exército: o Coronel Silver em '''O Exército Red Ribbon''', depois o General Red em '''Quartel-General da Red Ribbon''' e o Robô do General Black em '''O Robô de Batalha do Oficial Black''', ambos na Torre da Red Ribbon.
